Question: A 66-year-old client who is depressed, has rhythmic hand movements, and has a flattened affect is probably suffering from

Options: 
A. Huntington's disease
B. Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
C. Multiple Sclerosis
D. Alzheimer's disease
E. Parkinson's disease
F. Vascular Dementia
G. Frontotemporal Dementia
H. Schizophrenia
I. a right frontal lobe tumor
J. Bipolar Disorder

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
